ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7), and coach the driver on the required 'I'm Here' + 3-minute on-location wait before cancelling; no account flag warranted.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's no-show claim fails NS-1 (i): he never announced 'I'm Here' to the rider before the press time in the timeline (17:18:50); his only arrival message is timestamped 17:19:00, after that press time, and the system record of the press time overrides his statement. Without a valid 'I'm Here', NS-1 is not made out and NS-2 requires the fee to be refunded.
